[
  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness and for melanoma in situ.",
  "Surgical margins for melanoma should be based on tumor thickness.",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy, when indicated, should be performed before wide excision of the primary tumor.",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy should be performed in the same operative setting as wide excision whenever possible.",
  "When melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1–3 mm) margin to allow histological diagnosis.",
  "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as those on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions, and genitalia.",
  "The consensus rate for the primary excision recommendation is 100 % (21/21).",
  "The 7‑point melanoma checklist score is driven by the presence of a blue‑whitish veil (2 points) and irregular dots and globules (1 point).",
  "The blue‑whitish veil is defined as confluent blue pigment with an overlying white haze.",
  "Irregular dots and globules are described as irregularly distributed and varying in size.",
  "These features (blue‑whitish veil and irregular dots/globules) are key to the checklist’s melanoma suspicion.",
  "The blue‑whitish veil is a major criterion and the irregular dots and globules are a minor criterion for the checklist score."
]
